facades.name: east gable (entrance)
facades.note: Bottom to top: the three entrance doors; the 43 small square windows of the diamond lattice (nine staggered columns of 4, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 4), which the row clustering reads as one band because they are only 0.55 m apart. Columns: the nine lattice columns (the doors sit under columns). Peaks: the plain brick pier behind the south corner, the gable, and the tower beside it (the tower's east face is in the gable's plane), all three in the photo. Asymmetric because of the tower. Cropped to the gable block and the tower beside it (alongM) and below the belfry (heightM 20 m), leaving out the parish wing to the left.
